scenes.script:
VANESSA: "Ryan. Ryan, stop walking. Look who it is."
RYAN: "You have got to be kidding me."
VANESSA: "The bride and her prize. Oh my God, she really does push him around town."
MAYA: "Adrian, let us go the other way."
ADRIAN: "No."
VANESSA: "Maya. Maya Bennett. Or is it Maya Kane now? I read the registry filing. Everybody read it."
MAYA: "Excuse us. You are standing in front of the ramp."
RYAN: "Four days. Four days after our wedding you married this. Do you know how that makes me look?"
MAYA: "It makes you look like a man who ran off with someone else at his own wedding."
RYAN: "You did this to punish me."
MAYA: "I did this to keep my mother breathing. Not everything is about you, Ryan."
VANESSA: "Let me look at him. Stand up, sweetheart. Oh, wait. You cannot."
ADRIAN: "Move."
VANESSA: "It talks."
MAYA: "Do not touch the chair."
VANESSA: "Oops."
MAYA: "Adrian. Adrian, are you hurt? Do not move your neck. Look at my finger."
VANESSA: "Relax, nurse. He fell on the street, not off a building."
MAYA: "You pushed a wheelchair into traffic."
VANESSA: "I nudged it. And here, take a coffee. It looks like he spilled some on his legs. Whoops. That is hot. Very hot. But it does not matter, does it? He cannot feel anything down there anyway."
RYAN: "Vanessa, that is enough."
VANESSA: "Why? He is not going to feel it, Ryan. That is the whole joke."
MAYA: "There. That is for his legs."
VANESSA: "Did you just slap me? On a public street? Ryan, she slapped me."
RYAN: "Get on the ground."
MAYA: "Let go of my arm."
RYAN: "I said get down. You are a nobody, Maya. You have always been a nobody, and today the whole street gets to see it."
ADRIAN: "Ryan Prescott. Vanessa Hale. Say your names again. Loudly."
VANESSA: "Why? So you can cry about it later?"
ADRIAN: "So I remember them correctly."
VANESSA: "Look at him. Face down on the pavement, giving orders. That is the funniest thing I have seen all year."
ADRIAN: "Maya. Get up. Do not let them see you on the ground."
MAYA: "I am up. I am up, Adrian. I am fine."
ADRIAN: "Good. Now push. Do not look back at them. Push."

GỢI Ý DIỄN BIẾN: ADRIAN ăn thêm một miếng; MAYA đẩy đĩa lại gần anh hơn một chút rồi ngồi yên; ngọn đèn trần bóng đơn đung đưa chậm dần rồi đứng lại; ngoài cửa sổ là đêm. Model tự chọn cử chỉ cho hợp lý, không ai nói.

shots.goc: ADRIAN NÉT ngồi xe lăn cạnh bàn + MAYA NÉT ngồi ghế đối diện

scenes.script:
MAYA: "Hold still. This is going to sting where the coffee got you."
ADRIAN: "I cannot feel it."
MAYA: "You felt it this afternoon. I watched your jaw move."
ADRIAN: "You watch too closely."
MAYA: "It is my job. Lift the left leg for me. There. Adrian, these scars."
ADRIAN: "What about them."
MAYA: "This is not a car crash pattern. This is fourteen surgical entries. Two rods, six screws, and a plate here at the hip. Somebody very expensive put you back together."
ADRIAN: "Is that a question?"
MAYA: "No. This is a question. What is this folder in your drawer?"
ADRIAN: "You went through my drawer."
MAYA: "I went for gauze. The folder was on top of the gauze. It is an X-ray envelope, and it is not from a hospital. It says forensic vehicle inspection."
ADRIAN: "Put it back."
MAYA: "There is a photograph inside it. A brake line. And the cut on it is clean and straight. Brake lines do not tear straight, Adrian. They fray."
ADRIAN: "Maya."
MAYA: "Somebody cut it. Somebody cut your brake line and then everyone put you in a house with no ramp and called you useless."
ADRIAN: "Clause four."
MAYA: "Clause four says I do not ask about the accident."
ADRIAN: "Yes."
MAYA: "Then I am not asking. I am going to finish your dressings and then I am going to make you eat something, because you have eaten twice today and both times it was coffee."
ADRIAN: "You are angry."
MAYA: "I am furious. But not at you. Lift the other leg, please."
ADRIAN: "Maya."
MAYA: "Yes?"
ADRIAN: "Thank you for not asking."
MAYA: "You are welcome. Now eat."

scenes.script:
SEBASTIAN: "Mr. Halloran, do you know why I am in your office?"
MR. HALLORAN: "I was told a shareholder representative was coming. Nobody told me which one."
SEBASTIAN: "You have a sales director named Ryan Prescott."
MR. HALLORAN: "Yes. Mid-level. Decent numbers."
SEBASTIAN: "He no longer works here."
MR. HALLORAN: "Sir, I cannot just terminate a director without cause and process."
SEBASTIAN: "Then find cause and compress the process. You have twenty minutes."
MR. HALLORAN: "May I ask who is making this request?"
SEBASTIAN: "No."
MR. HALLORAN: "Ryan. Ryan, come in and close the door."
RYAN: "What is going on? Why is HR standing outside?"
MR. HALLORAN: "Your position has been eliminated. Effective immediately."
RYAN: "Eliminated? I closed four accounts last quarter."
MR. HALLORAN: "It is a restructuring decision."
RYAN: "A restructuring at eleven in the morning on a Wednesday? Who signed it?"
MR. HALLORAN: "I did."
RYAN: "You are lying. You are sweating through your shirt. Who is that man in the hallway?"
MR. HALLORAN: "Please hand your badge to security at the elevator."
RYAN: "No. I want to see the CEO. I want to see whoever owns this building."
MR. HALLORAN: "You do not want that, son."
RYAN: "I am marrying Vanessa Hale in three weeks. Do you understand what that means? Her father owns half this city."
MR. HALLORAN: "Ryan. Listen to me carefully, because I am about to do you the only favor I can. Whoever owns this building is not somebody her father says no to."
RYAN: "Then tell me the name."
MR. HALLORAN: "I do not know it. And I have run this floor for nine years."

scenes.script:
JUDGE WHITMORE: "We are here on the petition of Julian Kane regarding Adrian Kane. Counsel, proceed."
JULIAN'S LAWYER: "Your Honor, our position is simple. Adrian Kane sustained catastrophic spinal trauma six months ago. He is non-ambulatory. He lives alone in an unheated outbuilding. He has no professional care, no medical supervision, and no capacity to manage a multi-billion dollar estate."
JUDGE WHITMORE: "Mr. Julian Kane, do you wish to add anything?"
JULIAN: "Only that this is painful for our family, Your Honor. We love Adrian. But love means admitting when someone can no longer take care of himself. He recently married a stranger four days after meeting her. That alone should concern this court."
JUDGE WHITMORE: "Is the wife present?"
MAYA: "I am here, Your Honor."
JUDGE WHITMORE: "State your name and occupation."
MAYA: "Maya Kane. Registered nurse, critical care certified, six years in the intensive care unit at St. Agnes."
JULIAN'S LAWYER: "Your Honor, we object to testimony from an interested party."
JUDGE WHITMORE: "Overruled. She is a licensed clinician. Continue."
MAYA: "Patient is a thirty-four year old male, six months post incomplete spinal injury at T-eleven and T-twelve. He has partial sensation in both legs and measurable motor response in the right quadriceps. His medication list is baclofen ten milligrams three times daily, gabapentin three hundred at night, and a low dose blood thinner. Blood pressure this morning was one twenty-four over eighty. Skin is intact with no pressure ulcers, which after six months is not luck. It is care."
JUDGE WHITMORE: "You keep records?"
MAYA: "Twenty-nine days of them, Your Honor. Vitals twice daily, intake, output, range of motion, everything."
JULIAN'S LAWYER: "Twenty-nine days is not a history."
MAYA: "You are right. So let me tell you about the five months before I got there. His counsel just told this court that Mr. Kane lives in an unheated building with no ramp. That is true. Would you like to know who owns that building?"
JULIAN: "Your Honor."
MAYA: "Julian Kane does. He signed the transfer. I have the county record. This man cut off my husband's heat, took away his ramp, and then came to court and used the cold house as evidence that he cannot take care of himself."
JULIAN'S LAWYER: "Your Honor, this is inflammatory."
MAYA: "It is arithmetic. Your Honor, this man does not need a guardian. He needs his family to stop starving him and calling it mercy."
JUDGE WHITMORE: "The petition is denied. Mr. Julian Kane, I am ordering the heat and the accessibility modifications restored within seventy-two hours. Do not bring this back to my courtroom."
JULIAN: "Maya. Look at me for a moment."
MAYA: "I am looking."
JULIAN: "You just made a very expensive mistake, and you do not even know what it costs yet."

AI VÀ ĐANG LÀM GÌ: MAYA đứng ở chân ba bậc đá trước cửa nhà cổng, giữa bốn thùng carton và hai túi vải đã dọn ra sân. ADRIAN ngồi trong xe lăn điện cạnh cô. Trên đường phục vụ phía sau đỗ một xe tải nhỏ màu trắng mở thùng. Cạnh chiếc xe tải đó, hai người khuân đồ mặc áo bảo hộ xám đang bê thùng carton lên thùng xe.

TAY: MAYA một tay giữ mép một thùng carton, tay kia buông. ADRIAN hai tay đặt trên vành tay vịn.

HƯỚNG NHÌN: MAYA nhìn về phía đường phục vụ. ADRIAN nhìn theo hướng đó.

BIỂU CẢM: MAYA — người đang dọn nhà từ sáng sớm và chưa biết chuyện gì sắp tới: tóc buộc vội, tay áo xắn, mặt tập trung. ADRIAN — mặt bình, mắt tĩnh.

ĐÓNG BĂNG: đúng khoảnh khắc ngay TRƯỚC khi một chiếc xe khác rẽ vào đường phục vụ

scenes.script:
SHERIFF'S DEPUTY: "Ma'am, are you Maya Kane?"
MAYA: "Yes."
SHERIFF'S DEPUTY: "This is a notice to vacate. You have four hours."
MAYA: "Four hours? The judge just ordered the heat restored on Monday."
SHERIFF'S DEPUTY: "The judge ordered heat. He did not order tenancy. The owner has revoked permission to occupy."
JULIAN: "Hello, Maya."
MAYA: "Of course you came in person."
JULIAN: "I did not want to miss it. Effective this morning, Adrian's family allowance is suspended pending an internal review. His household staff is reassigned. His vehicle is repossessed."
MAYA: "He does not have a vehicle."
JULIAN: "I mean the chair."
MAYA: "The power wheelchair is a medical device."
JULIAN: "The power wheelchair was purchased with family funds and is family property. Boys, take it."
ADRIAN: "Take it."
MAYA: "Adrian, no."
ADRIAN: "Take it, Maya. Let them."
JULIAN: "Listen to him. He has learned. Here, cousin. There is an old manual chair in the shed. Consider it a gift."
MAYA: "The left wheel is bent."
JULIAN: "Then push harder. Oh, Maya, one more thing. The contract you signed. I have a copy. Twelve months, no touching, paid in cash. Any court in this state would call that what it is."
MAYA: "Call it whatever you want."
JULIAN: "You can leave right now, you know. Tear it up. Nobody would blame you. Nobody would even remember your name in a month."
MAYA: "Deputy, does the notice say four hours?"
SHERIFF'S DEPUTY: "Yes ma'am."
MAYA: "Then we will be gone in three. Adrian, we are going to Ridge Street. It is one room, forty-one dollars a week, and the water is hot most nights."
ADRIAN: "You could go."
MAYA: "I could."
ADRIAN: "Why not?"
MAYA: "Because you asked me that question twice today and both times you looked away before I answered. Adrian, look at me. I am putting the bed under the window."
ADRIAN: "Why the window?"
MAYA: "Because in the afternoon the sun comes over that building and it lands right there for two hours. You have been in the dark for six months. Two hours is not much, but it is what I have."

scenes.script:
VANESSA: "Send her in. Maya. Come in. Do not stand in the doorway like a delivery."
MAYA: "Your assistant said this was a job offer."
VANESSA: "It is. My grandmother is eighty-nine, she has congestive heart failure, and she refuses to miss my wedding. The family wants a private nurse in the room the whole day."
MAYA: "There are forty agencies in this city."
VANESSA: "I want you."
MAYA: "Why."
VANESSA: "Three thousand dollars for one day. Cash. Do you want it or not?"
MAYA: "What are the conditions?"
VANESSA: "You wear the uniform. The white one, the one that looks like a uniform. You do not sit at a table. You stand by the service door in the back and you are available at all times."
MAYA: "You want me standing in the corner in scrubs at your wedding."
VANESSA: "I want a qualified nurse present. If that is uncomfortable for you, take the agency job instead."
RYAN: "Take it, Maya."
MAYA: "Ryan."
RYAN: "You should come. Honestly. You should see what a real wedding looks like. Two hundred guests who actually show up. Live television. A dress that is not borrowed."
MAYA: "It is the same church."
VANESSA: "What?"
MAYA: "St. Michael's. You booked St. Michael's."
VANESSA: "We did. It has beautiful light in the afternoon."
MAYA: "You booked the church where he left me."
VANESSA: "Oh, honey. Do not flatter yourself. It is the best venue in the city. You just happened to be there first."
MAYA: "Three thousand dollars."
VANESSA: "Three thousand."
MAYA: "My mother's medication is eleven hundred a month and I lost my second job. Fine. I will take it."
VANESSA: "Wonderful. Ryan, write it down. The nurse is confirmed."
RYAN: "She is confirmed."
VANESSA: "And Maya. Bring the wheelchair man if you want. There is a step at the back door, but I am sure you will manage."

scenes.script:
HR DIRECTOR: "Maya, sit down. This is not going to be a long meeting."
MAYA: "I am on shift in twenty minutes."
HR DIRECTOR: "You are not on shift. Your access has been suspended."
MAYA: "On what grounds?"
HR DIRECTOR: "Falsification of patient records. Three charts flagged in an internal audit last night."
MAYA: "Which charts?"
HR DIRECTOR: "I am not authorized to discuss specifics."
MAYA: "I want to see them. Show me one entry with my login on it that is wrong."
HR DIRECTOR: "Maya."
MAYA: "You have known me six years. You wrote my recommendation letter. Show me one chart."
HR DIRECTOR: "I cannot."
MAYA: "You cannot, or there is nothing to show?"
HR DIRECTOR: "Did you know that Gerald Hale donated a new cardiac wing to this hospital on Tuesday? Forty million dollars. They announced it at nine in the morning."
MAYA: "And the audit started Tuesday night."
HR DIRECTOR: "The audit started Tuesday night."
MAYA: "So say it out loud. Say the real reason."
HR DIRECTOR: "I have two kids in college, Maya. I am not going to say it out loud. Security is waiting to walk you out."
MAYA: "Through the front? There are thirty people in that lobby right now."
HR DIRECTOR: "I am sorry. It is protocol for terminations involving records."
NURSE DIANE: "Maya? Maya, what is happening? Why is security holding your badge?"
MAYA: "Diane, listen to me. Bed twelve. Turn her every two hours, not every four. The left heel is the problem heel. Write it on the board so the night shift sees it."
NURSE DIANE: "Maya."
MAYA: "Every two hours, Diane. Please. Promise me."
NURSE DIANE: "I promise."
ADRIAN: "You are home early."
MAYA: "They let me go a little early tonight. Slow shift."
ADRIAN: "Slow shift."
MAYA: "Very slow. Are you hungry? I am going to make eggs."

scenes.script:
MAYA: "Adrian, the elevator is out. We have to use the ramp on the far side."
ADRIAN: "Maya. Stop pushing."
MAYA: "What?"
ADRIAN: "There are three men standing between the pillars and they have been standing there for four minutes."
THUG ONE: "Evening."
MAYA: "We are just going to our car."
THUG ONE: "You do not have a car. We checked."
THUG TWO: "Message from a family member. He says the guardianship hearing did not go the way it should have."
MAYA: "Do not touch that chair."
THUG ONE: "Down you go."
ADRIAN: "Maya, stay back."
THUG TWO: "Look at that. He rolled all the way to the drain."
THUG ONE: "Hold his hand flat. Flat, I said. Now this is for the courthouse."
ADRIAN: "Do it. Do not touch her."
MAYA: "Get off him. Get off him."
THUG TWO: "Lady, move."
MAYA: "No. You want his hands, you go through me."
THUG ONE: "She is not moving."
THUG TWO: "Then move her."
MAYA: "My hair. Let go of my hair."
THUG ONE: "Stay down, nurse."
MAYA: "Adrian, do not look. Do not look at me."
ADRIAN: "Maya."
MAYA: "I am fine. It is one finger. It is just one finger, it is nothing, I can splint it myself."
THUG ONE: "That is enough. He got the message. Let us go."
THUG TWO: "Tell your husband the family says hello."
MAYA: "Adrian. Adrian, can you hear me? Squeeze my hand. Not that hand, the other one."
ADRIAN: "Sebastian."
SEBASTIAN: "Sir, I am here. I am ninety seconds out. Sir, are you hurt?"
ADRIAN: "Sebastian. Bring it all back."
SEBASTIAN: "Sir, confirm the order."
ADRIAN: "All of it. Every board seat, every loan, every camera, every lawyer. Bring it all back."
SEBASTIAN: "And the timing, sir?"
ADRIAN: "Saturday. At the wedding."
MAYA: "Adrian, who are you talking to?"
ADRIAN: "Maya, give me your hand. The broken one."
MAYA: "It is not that bad."
ADRIAN: "Give it to me. Look at me. In four days, everything is going to change, and you are going to hate me for a few minutes."
MAYA: "Why would I hate you?"
ADRIAN: "Because I could have stopped this a long time ago."

scenes.script:
VANESSA: "Stop the music. Stop it, everyone."
GERALD HALE: "Sweetheart, what is wrong?"
VANESSA: "My necklace. It is gone. The Hale diamond. Two million dollars, Daddy, it was on the vanity ten minutes ago."
GERALD HALE: "Lock the doors. Nobody leaves this church."
SECURITY CHIEF: "Sir, we can search the staff."
VANESSA: "Start with the nurse."
MAYA: "I have been standing by the service door for two hours. Forty people have seen me."
VANESSA: "Then you will not mind, will you?"
SECURITY CHIEF: "Ma'am, open your bag."
MAYA: "Here."
SECURITY CHIEF: "Sir. It is here. It was in the side pocket."
GUEST ONE: "Oh my God. She stole it."
GERALD HALE: "A thief. At my daughter's wedding. In front of a television camera."
RYAN: "Maya. Maya, how could you?"
MAYA: "Ryan, you know me."
RYAN: "I thought I did. Cameras, are you getting this? Get closer. Everyone should see this."
VANESSA: "On your knees."
MAYA: "No."
VANESSA: "I said get on your knees and apologize to every person in this church."
MAYA: "I did not take it."
GERALD HALE: "The necklace was in your bag."
MAYA: "Somebody put it there."
VANESSA: "Oh, of course. The poor little nurse was framed. Ryan, hold her arm."
MAYA: "Let go of my sleeve. You are tearing it."
RYAN: "Then kneel and it stops."
MAYA: "I am not going to apologize for something I did not do. I have never apologized for something I did not do in my life and I am not starting in this church."
VANESSA: "Then I will help you."
MAYA: "My hand. That is my hand."
VANESSA: "I know. I can feel the splint under my heel. Down. Thieves belong on the floor."

MAYA: "How long?"
ADRIAN: "Three weeks. Four seconds at first. Then nine. Then thirty."
MAYA: "You let them push you out of that chair on the sidewalk. You let them."
ADRIAN: "I needed the names, and men only show you who they are when they think you cannot stand up."

SEBASTIAN: "It is not your church, Mr. Hale. The diocese sold this property eleven years ago."

MAYA: "Adrian. Adrian, who are you?"
ADRIAN: "I own Kane Holdings, Maya. All of it. I have owned it since I was twenty-nine."
MAYA: "Kane Holdings owns St. Agnes Hospital."

ADRIAN: "Yes."

sfs.prompt:
MÁY QUAY: trung 50mm, cao 1m55, cách ADRIAN 2m4, đặt trong lòng nhà thờ lấy cả hai người đứng

AI VÀ ĐANG LÀM GÌ: ADRIAN đứng thẳng ở nửa PHẢI khung, áo khoác dạ đen trên vai. SEBASTIAN đứng ở nửa TRÁI khung, một tay đưa lên ra hiệu về phía màn chiếu sau bàn thờ. Xung quanh là các cụm khách dự tiệc đứng im, vài người đã khép vòng lại gần hơn, mờ ngoài vùng nét.

TAY: ADRIAN một tay hất nhẹ về phía màn chiếu. SEBASTIAN một tay giơ lên ra hiệu, tay kia giữ bìa kẹp hồ sơ.

HƯỚNG NHÌN: ADRIAN nhìn về phía màn chiếu ngoài khung. SEBASTIAN nhìn ADRIAN.

scenes.script:
NURSE DIANE: "Maya. Maya, come quick. Bed twelve."
MAYA: "What happened? Is it her pressure?"
NURSE DIANE: "She opened her eyes. Eleven minutes ago. She is tracking. She squeezed my hand twice."
MAYA: "Mom. Mom, it is me. It is Maya."
HELEN: "Maya."
MAYA: "Do not talk. Just breathe. Small breaths, that is it."
HELEN: "How long?"
MAYA: "Seven months, Mom."
HELEN: "Who paid?"
MAYA: "A man paid. A stranger paid."
HELEN: "Strangers do not pay."
ADRIAN: "This one did, Mrs. Bennett."
MAYA: "Adrian. You walked all the way up here."
ADRIAN: "Fourth floor. Sixty-one steps. I counted."
HELEN: "Who are you?"
ADRIAN: "My name is Adrian Kane. I married your daughter, and I have two things to give her, and I would like you to be awake when I do it."
MAYA: "What are those?"
ADRIAN: "This is the contract. Twelve months, separate rooms, no questions. It is torn in half. It ended tonight."
MAYA: "And the second thing?"
ADRIAN: "A name plate. It is an old one, from the foot of a bed."
MAYA: "It says unidentified. Bed twelve."
ADRIAN: "Six months before your wedding, a man was brought into this unit with no wallet, no phone, and a spine broken in two places. His family had already told the press he was dead so the share price would settle. For nine days he had no name."
MAYA: "Bed twelve. That is this bed."
ADRIAN: "This bed. And every night at two in the morning a night shift nurse turned him, and cleaned him, and talked to him about the weather even though he never answered."
MAYA: "I do not remember."
ADRIAN: "You would not. You had four hundred patients that year. But you called me sir. Nine nights, and you never once called me the bed, or the injury, or the case. You said, good evening, sir."
MAYA: "That is all?"
ADRIAN: "That is everything. Do you understand now? I did not come to that church on your wedding day to marry you, Maya. I came to say thank you and go home. I sat in the back row with a check in my pocket for a nurse whose name I finally learned from a hospital roster."
MAYA: "And then Ryan walked in."
ADRIAN: "And then Ryan walked in."
MAYA: "Adrian, what are you doing? Your legs."
ADRIAN: "Give me a second. It is one knee. I can manage one knee."
HELEN: "Maya. Maya, he is on the floor."
MAYA: "He is not on the floor, Mom. He is kneeling."
ADRIAN: "Maya Bennett. I bought a year of your life with money because I did not think anybody would give it to me for free. That was the most arrogant thing I have ever done, and I am sorry. So I am asking properly this time, on my own two legs, in front of your mother, with nothing to offer you that you cannot walk away from."
MAYA: "You are the richest man in this state."
ADRIAN: "Not in this room. In this room I am bed twelve. Marry me, Maya."
MAYA: "There is no contract this time?"
ADRIAN: "There is no contract. There is no clause three. Ask me anything you want for the rest of your life."
MAYA: "Then I have one question."
ADRIAN: "Ask it."
MAYA: "Are your legs going to hold you until I say yes?"
ADRIAN: "For that? They will hold."
MAYA: "Then yes."
HELEN: "Maya."
MAYA: "Yes, Mom?"
HELEN: "Help the boy up."
